methodology: P/E uses reported owner profit for unmarked forecasts. EtNet rows are indicative vendor owner-profit estimates whose original broker adjustment conventions were not independently verified; marked with a dagger in the brief. Adjusted estimates are separately labelled and never substituted into reported rows.
Selected dated estimates, not consensus. No half-year annualisation.
Current issued shares are used without assuming conversion of out-of-money CBs. Anker H/A line-implied whole-company values use identical total shares and earnings.

Primary annual sales cross-checks cover targets and AInnovation, Saimo, SenseTime, Phancy, Deepexi, Tuya, UBTech. Manycore FY25 sales remain EtNet-sourced. A peer figures are from issuer annual filings or dated original broker tables/excerpts.

Unlock amounts cover identifiable original pre-IPO H holdings only. Non-H holdings, post-IPO options and OneRobotics founder extension are excluded where specified. These are release from identified IPO restrictions, not a prediction of selling or exemption from other insider rules.
SFC observation is 16 October, not contemporaneous borrow availability. All four are on HKEX designated short-sale list effective 23 October.
Official title search covers disclosures 1 December 2025 to 26 October 2026. DI search covers 1 July to 26 October 2026; subthreshold sales need not generate a DI filing.
limitations: No live Bloomberg or prime-broker borrow run.

Full Xueqiu articles were not accessible for every issuer; accessible 51WORLD article was read, Xunce search excerpts treated as leads only. Futu broker-authored excerpts read in full; not a retail sentiment poll.
Selected EtNet forward owner-profit estimates cannot be guaranteed to share all original broker adjustment conventions; exact original notes not available. They are labelled vendor forecasts.
Saimo quote 16.20 independently matched Tencent/Sina but reported zero trades on 26 October; indicative valuation reference, not executable hedge.
All four historically admitted to Southbound; current vendor eligibility flags match. Dynamic exchange current list was not downloaded in full. No new admission catalyst is assumed.
